facts.text: The Batman's real name is Bruce Wayne, a billionaire philanthropist.
facts.voiceNarration: Did you know the Dark Knight's secret identity is that of billionaire Bruce Wayne?
facts.imageDescription: Bruce Wayne standing in front of a Gotham City skyline at sunset, luxurious lifestyle

facts.text: Batman's origin story began with his parents' tragic murder as a child.
facts.voiceNarration: Young Bruce Wayne's life was forever changed by the brutal murder of his parents in front of him.
facts.imageDescription: A young Bruce Wayne standing at his parents' gravesite, Gotham City rainstorm

facts.text: The Batman's trusted sidekick is Robin, a young crime-fighter.
facts.voiceNarration: Robin has been the Dynamic Duo's trusty sidekick and protégé for years!
facts.imageDescription: Batman and Robin standing together in front of the Bat-Signal, superhero pose

facts.text: The Joker is one of Batman's most iconic villains, known for his chaotic nature.
facts.voiceNarration: He's unpredictable, insane, and has a twisted sense of humor - the Clown Prince of Crime!
facts.imageDescription: Joker laughing maniacally in front of a Gotham City backdrop, colorful crime scene

facts.text: Batman's utility belt is equipped with an array of gadgets to help him fight crime.
facts.voiceNarration: This trusty tool has become synonymous with the Dark Knight's heroics!
facts.imageDescription: Batman holding his utility belt, various gadgets and tools on display

facts.text: The Batman's butler Alfred Pennyworth is a loyal ally and confidant.
facts.voiceNarration: Alfred has been by Bruce Wayne's side through thick and thin!
facts.imageDescription: Alfred serving tea in the Wayne Manor study, classic British gentleman attire

facts.text: Commissioner James Gordon is a trusted ally and friend to Batman.
facts.voiceNarration: He's a true hero and a beacon of hope for Gotham City's citizens!
facts.imageDescription: Commissioner Gordon standing in front of the GCPD logo, determined expression

facts.text: The Batcave is Batman's secret headquarters and base of operations.
facts.voiceNarration: This high-tech lair has become a symbol of hope for Gotham City!
facts.imageDescription: Batman standing in front of the Bat-Signal at night, Batcave interior

facts.text: Lucius Fox is a close friend and business partner to Bruce Wayne.
facts.voiceNarration: He's a tech genius and one of Batman's most trusted allies!
facts.imageDescription: Lucius Fox working on advanced technology in the Batcave, futuristic equipment

facts.text: Batman's iconic vehicle is the Batmobile, an iconic symbol of justice.
facts.voiceNarration: The Batmobile has become synonymous with speed and protection!
facts.imageDescription: The Batmobile speeding through Gotham City streets at night, sleek design
